item.tib: sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i tshom bu tshogs kyi sgrub pa chen po'i bshad byang stong thun grub gnyis gter gyi bang mdzod
item.coloph: ces rig 'dzin gsang ba rtsal gyi stong thun bshad byang tshangs dbyangs dgyes pa'i gad mo las/ cung zad bkrol te sku gsum rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa'i tshom bu'i bshad sgrub la/ spyod bder stong thun grub gnyis rin chen gter gyi bang mdzod zhes bya ba 'di ni nye gnas mos slob du mas rten 'brel mtshams sbyar te bskul bas/ rigs sras rig 'dzin tshe dbang 'gyur med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bshad sgrab phrin las bstan pa rgyas pa'i gzhal med g.yung drung bkod pa'i khang du bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/
